data.assumption: “UK-யில் weekly capture ஆன GMV” என்பதை United Kingdom showrooms-இல் business_date அடிப்படையில் கடந்த 8 வாரங்களில் captured status உள்ள payment attempts-ன் amount_minor மொத்தம் என்று எடுத்துக்கொண்டேன்.
data.sql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('week', pa.business_date)::date AS week_start,
  SUM(pa.amount_minor) AS captured_gmv_minor
FROM payment_attempts pa
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pa.order_id
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN countries c ON c.country_code = s.country_code
WHERE pa.is_test = false
  AND o.is_test = false
  AND c.name = 'United Kingdom'
  AND pa.status = 'captured'
  AND pa.business_date >= DATE '2026-09-10' - INTERVAL '8 weeks'
  AND pa.business_date <= DATE '2026-09-10'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', pa.business_date)::date
ORDER BY week_start
